messages:
alex: Quick heads-up - prototyping an automatic-degrade flow (working name: "Sherpa") that picks a degrade mode when we see service stress. Want quick UX + API sanity check. Core ideas: two primary degrade modes (lite model switch, and cached-prefix return), triggers based on p95 latency and 5xx spikes, and a compact audit trail for every decision. Ping @maria @jordan for console/telemetry thoughts.

maria: Nice. :sherpa: Audit should be concise but actionable: decision_id, trigger_signal, fallback_type, from_model, to_model, input_hash, operator_override (if any). Also keep a human-readable reason string for UI.

jordan: Agree. UI needs hysteresis info - when it started, how many requests affected, and last sample trace link. For internal API, prefer returning a `decision_trace_url` to avoid shipping huge payloads to clients.

paul: Trigger suggestion: combine both latency and error-rate thresholds, e.g. `p95 > 500ms for 30s` OR `5xx_rate > 3% over 60s`. Also add a short-term spike guard so transient blips don't flip you. We should let clients indicate preference via header `x-redwood-fallback-preference: prefer-lite|prefer-cached|no-fallback` but default to policy.

tia: From operator POV - need an easy sticky-override in console (with TTL and reason). When an operator applies override record name + ticket id and append to audit. Also add a simulate button in the UI.

alex: Drafting a minimal event shape for the audit (JSON preview):

{
  "decision_id": "uuid-1234",
  "trigger": "p95_latency",
  "trigger_value": "620ms",
  "fallback_mode": "lite",
  "from_model": "redwood/large-v1",
  "to_model": "redwood/medium-q4",
  "input_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "reason_human": "p95 exceeded 500ms for 30s",
  "operator_override": "paul (sticky, 15m)",
  "decision_trace_url": "https://console/redwood/decisions/uuid-1234"
}

maria: That shape looks good. Small additions: include `sample_output_url` (for repro) and `sample_input_excerpt` optionally (but encrypted/opt-in). Default retention 90 days, enterprise option for longer. Anonymize or store only hashes unless customer explicitly enables raw input retention.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout of `autodegrade` enabled in staging cluster `sherpa-stg` at 1749821510

jordan: UX idea - in Rollouts view show a compact card: current policy, last triggered, affected qps, estimated cost delta when degraded (server-side computed). The simulate button should run N synthetic queries and show p95/cost heatmap.

paul: On API naming: can we standardize on `fallback_mode` (values: `lite|cached|reject|queue`) and `fallback_reason_code` (enum) so analytics can aggregate quickly? Also we should add `hysteresis_until` timestamp for clarity.

alex: Great feedback. Next steps: I'll open a PR with the proto + console mockups and wire up the `decision_trace_url`. @paul can you draft the trigger spec doc with exact numeric thresholds and backoffs? @tia can you stub the operator runbook for sticky override and simulation steps? I'll add telemetry retention defaults and opt-in controls. Thanks all. :+1:
